name: Buryatia (Buryat SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Бурятская ССР / Буряадай ССР' in Russian and Buryat in yellow.
history: The 1978 flag of the Buryat ASSR, patterned on the flag of the RSFSR, with the inscription changed after the republic's declaration of sovereignty in October 1990 renamed it the Buryat SSR. It was replaced on 29 October 1992 by the present blue, white and yellow flag.

features.role: inscription 'Бурятская ССР / Буряадай ССР' in Russian and Buryat
